resolvedQuestions.text: For the ~200 links that resolve into .opencode/: what does each point at, relative or absolute, does the consuming runtime resolve that position at all, and why is .claude/skills a link while .hermes/skills/ is a real generated directory?
resolvedQuestions.answer: 174 external links (56 .claude, 53 .cursor, 22 .devin, 19 .pi, 19 .codex, 2 .hermes, 3 specs archive), all relative, none absolute; brief's 200 overcounts (.pytest_cache absent, specs 3 not 4). Five link shapes. Internal .opencode links: 208 (203 in, 1 out, 4 broken). Asymmetry deliberate: Hermes scanner quarantines symlinked skill dirs → generated copies; .claude/agents real fork due to lossy dialect; Codex/Pi generated dialect trees; hook mirror trees are discovery-only while JSON configs carry the executed .opencode strings.

resolvedQuestions.text: For each of the seven runtimes, where does it read skills, commands, agents, hooks and plugins from, and is that path configurable or hardcoded to the runtime's own directory name?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Seven contracts, all keyed to the runtime's own directory name; no relocatable path exists in any repo-visible config. opencode: .opencode/{skills,commands,agents,plugins} + opencode.json:15 MCP. Claude: .claude/{skills link,commands,agents fork,settings.json}. Codex: generated .codex/{prompts,agents} + outbound ~/.codex/hooks.json; [agents.*] wiring UNKNOWN (contradiction). Cursor: .cursor/{commands,agents→.claude,rules,hooks.json}. Devin: .devin/agents/<n>/AGENT.md + native .opencode/skills scan (symlink-traversal UNKNOWN). Pi: .pi/{skills link,prompts generated,extensions native}; .pi/agents has no live consumer. Hermes: .hermes/{skills generated copies,plugins opt-in} behind trust grant.

resolvedQuestions.text: Every artifact that stores a .opencode path as data: which command regenerates each, and which paths are absolute vs repo-relative?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Regenerate: trigger-index.json (1,809 refs, generate-trigger-index.mjs), compiled routing closure + serving-closure.manifest.json (compiled-route-sync.cjs, has a spec-tree --verify move simulation), four dist trees (90 files; npm run build per package; all untracked), hash-only dist-freshness attestations (survive a pure move), spec metadata (repair-derived.cjs --apply). Rewrite: 295 code files constructing paths (root-finder probes fail hard without .opencode/skills), skill-root graph-metadata.json key_files (authored, no generator). Clean: leaf manifests, description.json. SQLite: council-graph.sqlite rows + skill-graph.sqlite runtime path (launcher-ipc-bridge.cjs:98). Absolute class: 517 files (264 JSON) fail silently at the old checkout.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which hooks, validators, naming guards and CI workflows would reject the migration commit, and what order must they be taught the new path in?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Mirror parity blocks a rename commit (MIRROR_SOURCES matches old paths; only SPECKIT_SKIP_MIRROR_PARITY=1 escapes; missing scripts skip silently). Agent mirror-sync blocks with no bypass flag. Comment hygiene silently disengages if .opencode/skills/sk-code vanishes. Route/spec re-mint block when they cannot fix. The 7 installed hooks are symlinks from ~/.config/git/hooks into the MAIN checkout's .opencode/scripts/git-hooks — they dangle before any gate can run. 19 workflows keyed to .opencode/** filters; 12 of 19 silent-skip when a guard is missing. 'skilled' is already a release-branch namespace.

resolvedQuestions.text: Which references live outside the repository and will silently keep pointing at the old path?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Four live .opencode-naming references: 7 git-hook symlinks (~/.config/git/hooks → main checkout), ~/.codex/hooks.json (18 command strings), ~/.hermes/config.yaml mcp_servers args, ~/.codex/config.toml [projects.".../Public/.opencode"] trust entry. Survives (checkout-root-keyed): ~/.codex projects + hooks.state, ~/.hermes trusted_project_dirs, ~/.claude.json, ~/.pi/agent/* → .pi/* symlinks, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md. Clean negatives: ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.config/devin/*, ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.claude/plugins. ~/.zshrc $HOME/.opencode/bin entry is stale (dir absent). No in-repo validator covers this class.

resolvedQuestions.text: Does git mv preserve history at this size; what happens to symlinks traversing the moved directory; one commit or staged; any cached absolute path that survives?
resolvedQuestions.answer: 17,766 tracked files under .opencode (17,360 regular, 198 exec, 208 symlinks) vs one .skilled/.gitkeep. The repo's own large-reorg playbook governs: git mv over raw mv+add; pure renames in a separate commit from content edits; verify R-status; post-merge zero-tracked-files-under-old-prefix sweep; toolchain + reindex on main after merge; gitignored DBs snapshotted first. 174 external links dangle at once; 208 internal links travel intact; 9 ignored entries (5 node_modules, 4 untracked dist trees, 1 marker) do not move. .skilled/ existing makes git mv .opencode .skilled nest. Cached absolute paths enumerated (SQLite rows, ~/.codex trust, plist template, ~/.claude.json prose); worktree .git pointer unaffected; memory/vector DB location UNKNOWN.

resolvedQuestions.text: Of the ~3,000 tracked markdown files naming the path, which mentions are load-bearing instructions and which are prose?
resolvedQuestions.answer: 3,035 files excl specs (27,696 incl). 816 carry fenced-block runnable refs (rewrite-critical: 111 SKILL.md, 217 references, 47 commands, 45 hooks, 36 agents); 2,219 inline-only. 100 generated stubs regenerate-only. Root docs: README 52, PUBLIC-RELEASE 33, AGENTS.md 9, CONTRIBUTING 3, REPO RULES.md 0 (brief correction). 1,710 evidence/prose (manual-testing-playbook 1,054 + benchmark 368 + changelog 288) freeze; feature-catalog 270 + assets 60 triage; specs 24,661 out of rewrite scope.

keyFindings.text: External census: 174 links into .opencode, not 200; .pytest_cache absent; specs has 3; internal .opencode links = 208 (excl node_modules)
Four mechanisms are deliberate: symlink, generated copies (.hermes scanner), generated dialect (.codex/.pi), real fork (.claude agents)
Hook mirror symlinks are discovery-only; runtimes execute literal .opencode/... strings from settings.json / hooks.json / hooks.v1.json
UNKNOWN: whether Devin's native .opencode/skills discovery traverses a symlinked tree — the only zero-mirror skill consumer
Seven runtimes, seven discovery contracts, all keyed to the runtime's own directory name; no repo-visible relocation key in any
Seven MCP registrations carry the same relative .opencode/bin/mcp-code-mode-launcher.cjs string; the launcher appends a literal .opencode/skills/... path and requires built dist/index.js
Generated runtime files (.codex/prompts, .pi/prompts stubs, .codex/agents/*.toml bodies) are runtime-consumed text naming .opencode paths → regenerate, not rewrite
Contradiction: cli-codex README claims [agents.*] config_file wiring that exists in neither config; UNKNOWN what wires the 12 TOML agents
trigger-index.json carries 1,809 .opencode repo-relative paths; regenerate with generate-trigger-index.mjs; un-regenerated it silently surfaces stale paths
295 code files construct .opencode paths at runtime; root-finder probes test .opencode/skills existence and throw if absent — ordering-sensitive
Build attestations are hash-only and path-independent — survive a pure move, invalidated by the rebuild not the rename
Skill-root graph-metadata.json key_files is authored (no generator) and carries repo-relative .opencode paths — text rewrite is legitimate there
517 files carry checkout-absolute paths (264 JSON) — fail silently at the old checkout; only content scans see them
Mirror parity and agent mirror-sync block a rename commit (latter with no bypass); comment hygiene silently disengages if .opencode/skills/sk-code disappears
The 7 installed git hooks are home-level symlinks into the MAIN checkout's .opencode/scripts/git-hooks — they dangle before any gate can run
19 workflows keyed to .opencode/** path filters; 12 of 19 skip silently when a guard script is missing — stale paths convert blocking checks into green-but-unchecked
Four live external .opencode-naming references (git hooks, ~/.codex/hooks.json, ~/.hermes MCP args, ~/.codex trust entry); path-keyed state survives; no validator covers the class
The repo's own large-reorg playbook governs q7: git mv, pure-rename commit separate from content edits, R-status verify, old-prefix sweep, toolchain on main
git mv carries no ignored content: 9 ignored entries incl. all 4 dist trees (tracked=0) and 5 node_modules; rebuild on main after merge
Doc treatment table: 816 rewrite-critical, 100 regenerate-only stubs, ~2,000 cosmetic/frozen, specs 24,661 out of scope
